I’ll check the Anthropic request conversion and relevant tests, then update the shared adapter so Claude on Vertex gets the same fix. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
Claude on Vertex inherits the shared Anthropic adapter, so one change covers both providers and streaming requests. The adapter now removes `parallel_tool_calls` for every value and adds `disable_parallel_tool_use: true` only when the value is `false` and the tool choice supports it. I’m adding regression coverage for those combinations.
The test files could not load because the supplied environment lacks `slowapi`; pytest also hit a sandbox restriction while checking child processes. I’ll leave dependencies unchanged and run a direct check of both adapters across the relevant tool-choice and parallel-call combinations.
Updated the shared Anthropic adapter, covering Claude on Vertex and streaming requests:

- Always removes `parallel_tool_calls`.
- When `false`, adds `disable_parallel_tool_use: true` to named, automatic, or required tool choices.
- Leaves disabled or omitted tool choices unchanged.

Added regression coverage. All 80 direct adapter checks passed. The relevant pytest files were blocked by missing `slowapi`; no dependencies were installed.
